final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802.0 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT s.account_id, s.A3, s.avg_amount, s.avg_amount - t.overall_avg FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.avg_amount - t.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
